name: overview
prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve plus scene variation. Image 1 is the CURRENT EDIT TARGET and the accepted pixel style/character reference. Image 2 is an ADDITIONAL VISUAL STYLE reference for mood and setting only, not a scene to copy. Create a revised wide 3:1 book illustration. KEEP the accepted old PC adventure-game look: visible square pixels, crisp dark outlines, checkerboard dithering, flat limited-color shading, convincing vintage CRT/computer hardware. Keep the same recognizable two fictional adult characters: dark hooded attacker seen from behind, short dark-haired defender in teal shirt, face visible in front-three-quarter view. REMOVE ALL HEADSETS, headphones, microphones, ear cups, headbands and earpieces from the defender; show natural uncovered hair and ears. Headset is not relevant to the story.

The old illustration repeats frozen typing poses. This revision MUST show the distinct chapter-specific posture/action described below, different from other chapters. Allow a new desk arrangement and background suited to that action. Preserve coherent physical perspective, grounded furniture, plausible anatomy and ordinary-sized props. Attacker remains BACK TO CAMERA without a visible face; defender's face remains visible. When defender uses a monitor, its SCREEN faces HER, viewer sees back/side, never a second screen on its back. Do not force all screen contents into view. Both characters have exactly two arms with natural hands, no duplicate fingers/limbs. No giant magnifying glass, floating paper/UI, speech bubbles, readable text, letters, logos or arrows. No unrequested action/adventure props. Left attacker / central hardware / right defender role layout must remain understandable for the labels beneath, but do not repeat the identical room from image 1. Vary actual narrative action, not just small hand gestures. Keep heads fully in frame. Scene: An airy daytime training lab with large rectangular windows, a distant small courtyard with greenery and pale cyan daylight; warm beige desks, muted pink architectural accents. Attacker on left sits upright, shoulders squared, deliberately entering a command with both hands. Center is a compact half-height server rack plus small network switch, distinct equipment silhouettes. Defender on right has leaned forward attentively toward her monitor, one hand operating a mouse on the desk and the other resting by the keyboard, a focused neutral expression without headset. Her leaning shoulder line and mouse posture should visibly differ from the earlier frozen straight-seated typing pose. Background has daylight and an open spacious feel, not the previous violet office door and bookcase scene.
